description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView component used to display log data in an Android application. It formats log entries and appends them to the view, supporting log chaining via the LogNode interface.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView used for outputting log data received through the LogNode interface, with methods for formatting and displaying log messages.

methods.name: LogView
methods.description: Constructors for creating LogView instances with different initialization parameters.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, including priority, tag, message, and throwable, then updates the display and chains the log if applicable.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
